original.question: Benny te wè yon 10-pye makakòd ak 2 6-pous remora ki tache sou li. Ki pousantaj nan longè kò makakòd la se longè total remora yo?
original.answer:
An premye, jwenn longè total remora yo an pous: 6 pous/remora * 2 remora = <<6*2=12>>12 pous.
Answit, divize chif sa a pa 12 pou konvèti l an pye: 12 pous / 12 pous/pye = <<12/12=1>>1 pye.
Answit, divize longè total remora a an pye pa longè makakòd la epi miltipliye pa 100% pou eksprime repons lan kòm yon pousantaj: 1 pye / 10 pye * 100% = 10%
